PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Machine learning engineer with six years taking models from notebook to
production. Builds training pipelines in Python and PyTorch, owns the MLOps
tooling around them — experiment tracking, model registry, reproducible
training — and treats evaluation design as the core of the job. Comfortable
writing the SQL feature pipelines that feed the models.

SKILLS
- Languages: Python (typing, packaging, async), SQL, some Go
- Modelling: PyTorch (training loops, fine-tuning, quantisation), scikit-learn
- MLOps: experiment tracking, model registries, feature stores, reproducible
  training with pinned environments and data versioning
- Evaluation: offline evaluation suites, drift monitoring, A/B analysis
- Serving: FastAPI model services, batch scoring, GPU inference tuning
